trino_query_latencies.name: Fleet Aggregation & KPI Stats
trino_query_latencies.query: SELECT AVG(health_score), MIN(predicted_rul_hours), MAX(failure_probability) FROM postgres.public.asset_current_state

trino_query_latencies.name: Prescriptive Maintenance Ordered Scan
trino_query_latencies.query: SELECT * FROM postgres.public.maintenance_priority_queue ORDER BY ranking ASC LIMIT 10

trino_query_latencies.name: Alert Severity Grouping
trino_query_latencies.query: SELECT severity, COUNT(*) FROM postgres.public.asset_alert_history GROUP BY severity

trino_query_latencies.name: Cross-Catalog Federated Join Baseline
trino_query_latencies.query: SELECT r.name, count(*) as count FROM tpch.sf1.nation n JOIN tpch.sf1.region r ON n.regionkey = r.regionkey GROUP BY r.name
